remarks: A rare opportunity to own a remarkable Tudor Revival home showcasing timeless elegance, exceptional craftsmanship, and architectural distinction. Built circa 1892 on a generous city lot, this architectural gem welcomes you with a magnificent two-story entry, original natural woodwork, gleaming hardwood floors, leaded glass, and abundant natural light. Currently configured as two spacious, nearly identical units, each offers generously sized rooms, updated kitchens with high-end appliances, and updated mechanics. The first floor presents an exceptional opportunity for rental income, professional offices, executive suites, or a boutique setting for intimate weddings, private events, film shoots, or photography sessions. Its grand architectural details, elegant gathering spaces, and charming kitchen with built-in booth seating create a distinctive atmosphere for residents, clients, or guests. The second floor unit offers an equally impressive living space, highlighted by a Wolf range and timeless architectural charm. A beautiful sunroom surrounded by windows provides a bright, inviting retreat. Recently redecorated, the interiors preserve the craftsmanship of the era while offering modern conveniences. Separate utilities, central air, forced-air heating, and full, dry basements add practicality. The unfinished third floor offers potential for three additional bedrooms or flexible space. Outside, distinctive Tudor rooflines, decorative woodwork, a three-story tower, and a grand covered driveway entrance create an impressive arrival. A detached garage with a new roof and charming rounded tower adds to the property's appeal. Situated on prestigious Summer Street near Allentown, Elmwood Village, Symphony Circle, Kleinhan's Music Hall, the Buffalo AKG Art Museum, and Delaware Park. An exceptional opportunity to enjoy historic elegance while exploring residential, rental, or business possibilities. Also listed as a commercial building under MLS# B1722688
